items.title: DeepCell
items.source_text: DeepCell Your deadline survival kit for office work Deepcell can help you with deadline tasks that require narrations, calculation and presentation at the same time, such as modeling, sales review, budget forecast and monthly report. DeepCell (both web app and agent plug-in) can create ready-to-use docs, spreadsheets, and slides—with sources and cheat sheets to help you explain. Furthermore, every edit can update related parts. The product is built on a newly designed document format (.deepcell), which is especially designed for system two tasks. Productivity Artificial Intelligence Business

items.title: Claude Duet
items.source_text: Claude Duet Proactive agent that understands what needs your attention Claude Duet is a helpful, proactive agent you hand off work to through messages. Tell it what you need and it works on its own computer in the cloud, using apps you connect. It messages you when it is done or needs a decision from you. While it’s always on, it uses good judgment when it reaches out and knows what can wait. Messaging Artificial Intelligence Bots

items.title: heal.dev
items.source_text: heal.dev Find bugs and vulnerabilities code review misses Code review catches what’s wrong in a diff. Heal catches what breaks when the app runs. Heal learns how to run your application, builds a production-like sandbox with external services stubbed, then hunts for bugs, performance regressions, and runtime vulnerabilities users would hit. It reproduces every defect before reporting it, so you get real bugs to fix, not a backlog of AI-generated suspicions. Developer Tools Artificial Intelligence Vibe coding

items.title: Mistral Voxtral 3
items.source_text: Mistral Voxtral 3 Mistral’s speech models for transcription, TTS and agents Voxtral 3 is Mistral’s new family of speech-to-text and text-to-speech models, plus a voice agent SDK built on LiveKit. Transcription covers 50+ languages with diarization and context biasing, and realtime transcription runs under 500ms. TTS adapts emotion and pacing, with voice cloning from 30+ minutes of audio. Batch transcription starts at $0.0035 per minute, and the models are available through Mistral’s API. Artificial Intelligence
